subject: Security notification: suspected exfil of inference logs — tabletop and artifact request
messages:
From: Ami Patel <ami.patel@finnova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@finnova.com
Date: 2026-11-29 09:12 PST
Subject: Initial security notification: suspected data exfil related to inference logs

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick heads-up from our security team — we've identified anomalous access patterns to an S3 bucket that stores anonymized inference telemetry (request IDs and minimal metadata). At first glance it looks like a narrow set of objects was copied externally; we don't believe customer PII was present in the exported files but we need to confirm.

What we need from Redwood as soon as possible:
- Confirmation of your incident response point of contact and escalation path
- A copy of your IR playbook or an executive summary of containment/forensics steps you will apply
- An initial export of inference-serving access logs and KV cache snapshots for the window 2026-11-25 00:00 UTC — 2026-11-28 23:59 UTC
- Answers to a short SOC 2 / SIG checklist we will send (auth/access logs, retention policy, audit trail availability)

Can Redwood join a 45-minute tabletop on Thursday, Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through containment and evidence handoff? Sec-ops will upload a small log summary to the secure bucket and share the link after we confirm the tabletop time.

Attachments: finnova_initial_log_summary.csv (summary rows, no customer identifiers)

Thanks — I know this is time sensitive, appreciate quick confirmation.

Ami Patel
Director, Security Operations
FinnovA Inc.
ami.patel@finnova.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ami Patel <ami.patel@finnova.com>, sec-ops@finnova.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Initial security notification: suspected data exfil related to inference logs

Ami — thanks for the alert and the summary. Soojin here (Head of Security Partnerships at Redwood). We're standing up a focused response and can do the tabletop on Thu Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT. Confirmed.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- I'll be the primary external POC for this engagement. Secondary lead is Marissa (cc'd) for evidence coordination. For forensics we will route technical artifacts to Neha.
- Please upload the initial log bundle to the secure Drive link below (we'll pull once your upload completes): https://drive.redwood.company/shared/finova-uploads/ — we prefer encrypted uploads and a short HMAC for integrity check.
- We'll provide an IR playbook executive summary and a minimal evidence checklist by EOD today. Attached is a short IRP summary and our standard evidence manifest template (redwood_irp-summary.pdf).

A few clarifying questions so we scope collection correctly:
1) Do you have the object names or prefixes that were copied (we need exact keys to reduce noise)?
2) Are there any active user sessions you see that we should block immediately?
3) Does FinnovA have a forensic copy already or should Redwood assume primary collection for the time window?

What we'll bring to the tabletop:
- Containment plan (token rotation, ephemeral cred invalidation, ACL snapshot)
- List of artifacts we can produce quickly (auth logs, presigned-url audit, KV snapshots, runtime model variant map, kernel-level request traces)
- Timeline of our retention and deletion controls for inference telemetry

I will redact any customer identifiers if we retrieve artifacts from our systems. Marissa — can you prepare the evidence manifest (we'll attach a draft in the thread) and confirm the capacity to produce the KV cache snapshot for the requested window?

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Head, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ami Patel <ami.patel@finnova.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30 08:18 PST
Subject: Re: Initial security notification: suspected data exfil related to inference logs

Adding runbook context and artifact expectations.

Ami / team — thanks for flagging. Operational notes from our side:
- We can produce auth/access logs for the timeframe listed and will include presigned-URL usage, IAM role assume logs, and router-level ingress IPs.
- KV cache snapshots (model-facing cache state) are exportable but will require coordination and a short maintenance window to avoid service disruption; estimate 20 minutes of low-impact maintenance during which we'll quiesce affected worker replicas. We'll confirm a slot during the tabletop.
- We'll also capture runtime model variant mapping so you can correlate request IDs to model versions and quantization profiles.

I've attached our IRP runbook (irp_runbook_v2.docx) and an evidence manifest (evidence_manifest_20261130.csv) that lists the artifact types, collection owner, expected TTL, and redaction notes. Neha — can you lead forensics once Ami provides the object keys? She will coordinate a secure transfer and hashing.

Quote of original for context:
> On 2026-11-29 09:12 PST, Ami Patel wrote:
> > Quick heads-up from our security team — we've identified anomalous access patterns to an S3 bucket that stores anonymized inference telemetry...

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ami Patel <ami.patel@finnova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@finnova.com
Date: 2026-12-02 11:03 PST
Subject: Re: Initial security notification: suspected data exfil related to inference logs

Team — thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. We have uploaded the initial artifact bundle and object index to the secure bucket and added the integrity HMAC in the upload notes. Link (internal): https://drive.redwood.company/shared/finova-uploads/finova_initial_bundle_20261129.zip

Confirming the tabletop for Thu Dec 2, 10:00 AM PT. Our CTO and lead forensics will attend, and we'll provide the object keys during the session. We'll also route a short SOC 2 checklist (requested fields) to Soojin after the tabletop; early heads-up: we may need a short statement about log retention and audit trail completeness for our compliance review.

I have also started an NDA/engagement signature via DocuSign for evidence exchange — link: https://docusign.com/some-long-id

We'll see you on the call.

Best,
Ami
Director, Security Operations
FinnovA Inc.
ami.patel@finnova.com
